context:
Goal: degen's Mac suite leg proves PR #702 (batch 24g), so the next degen merge can go.
Problem (money): the Mac run 43472967936 (self-hosted macbook-pro-2, label degen-mac) did start, but its checkout step hung and the job failed at 18:18 UTC, 10 minutes after it began; the cause is unknown. Another run costs macOS time, and a red leg blocks the next degen merge.
Based on (read): runner 11's read of the run at 16:00 CST, relayed by the coordinator; job https://github.com/shivinate7/degen/actions/runs/43472967936/job/132049451962. Past rulings: none found on re-running a Mac leg. Triage has not read the run.
Departs from: degen as it stands (#702 is red on its Mac leg; #703 and #704 wait behind it) — option a re-runs that leg once; option b drops #702.
Meanwhile: runner 11 holds degen. mailaudit #323 merged at 15:58 CST (main bbdf226, runner 11's read).
lastAnswer: 770 a: re-run the Mac suite leg of #702 once.

options.gain: #702 can merge on a real Mac run.
options.label: Re-run the Mac suite leg of #702 once (Recommended)
options.lose: macOS spend, and a second hang costs another 10 minutes.

options.label: Drop #702
options.lose: Its change waits, and #703 and #704 stay held behind it.

owner: runner 11 (session_013NEJKzRugXqBZrZ8xwXmW7), via the coordinator; posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
reply: Filed as ruling own-770-a-degen-702-mac-rerun and sent to runner 11. Note: run 43472967936 used the self-hosted Mac although degen defaults to the hosted runner; I asked runner 11 to re-run it on the hosted runner, since your Mac is offline.
title: Re-run degen PR #702's hung Mac test leg once, or drop the PR?
why: The Mac leg hung for 10 minutes with the cause unknown; a re-run costs macOS time and a red leg blocks degen's next merge.
